systems.name: 1.1 Vehicle Movement Model
systems.notes: Built — racer/vehicle.js: acceleration with top-speed cap, speed-sensitive steering, handbrake drift with countersteer angle control, and a drift charge → tiered boost system (blue/orange/purple).
tasks: Acceleration and top-speed cap per vehicle

systems.name: 1.2 Collision & Wall Bounce
systems.notes: Built — spline-border sphere collision with shallow-angle bounce + speed loss and sticky drag to punish wall riding. Non-solid wall runs open drivable gaps.
tasks: Sticky collisions at high speed (prevent wall riding)

systems.name: 1.3 Ground Detection & Jump Mechanics
systems.notes: Built — spline-slope launch, ramp-lip auto-boost, in-air pitch control with flip reward, landing impact + speed retention, fall-off respawn, and smoothed downhill ground-follow.

systems.name: 1.4 Camera System
systems.notes: Built — dynamic third-person chase cam (chasecam.js) with drift offset, groundHeightAt floor clamp, smoothed view pitch, and snap on respawn.
